author: Michael Masouras (US)
quote: if, for whatever reason, you bump into a limit during the year, they will auto-upgrade you to a higher price *for the entire year*
full_text: Hubspot starts off nice with a free tier, but then costs ramp up very quickly for anything meaningful. In addition, the terms for signing a yearly contract are extremely onerous: if, for whatever reason, you bump into a limit during the year, they will auto-upgrade you to a higher price *for the entire year* [...] Even if you go under the limit, they will not remove the charge for every single month for the rest of the year. It's the most predatory pricing I have ever witnessed.
